verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform and API, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers and uses their tools is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Flutterwave has any agent or MCP-host capability; its llms.txt and docs.md files are documentation formats for machines to read, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
